task: Publish close-out claims for the pnpm workspace migration.
output_summary: The final response will state that the repository's Node projects were migrated to a pnpm workspace, project package-lock files were removed, pnpm/Corepack commands were verified, and official pnpm/Corepack documentation was checked.

evidence.reliability: Tracked workspace configuration files created for this migration.
Tracked project manifests updated to declare the pnpm package manager and pnpm-compatible scripts.

evidence.source: pnpm-lock.yaml; git status shows workspace-monitor/package-lock.json, platform-desktop-app/package-lock.json, and presentation-agent/package-lock.json deleted
evidence.reliability: The new workspace lockfile is tracked and the deleted package-lock files are visible in repository status.

evidence.source: corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; corepack pnpm audit --prod=false; corepack pnpm --filter workspace-monitor test/check/build/perf:budget/check:intent-map/check:intent-map:customer; corepack pnpm --filter platform-desktop-app test/check/monitor:build; corepack pnpm --filter presentation-agent-browser-validation test:browser
evidence.reliability: Local command results recorded during the migration verification pass.
Official pnpm 10 settings documentation for workspace overrides and build-script dependency policy.

claims.statement: The repository now has a root pnpm workspace pinned to pnpm@10.34.1.
verification_steps: Read the root package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, and updated project package.json files.

claims.statement: The old project-level package-lock.json files were replaced by a root pnpm-lock.yaml.
verification_steps: Checked repository status and lockfile presence after migration.

claims.statement: The pnpm migration verification commands passed locally.
verification_steps: Ran the listed Corepack/pnpm install, audit, test, check, build, customer, and browser validation commands.

claims.statement: The migration used official pnpm workspace, pnpm settings, pnpm installation, and Node Corepack documentation as external references.
verification_steps: Checked the official documentation pages on 2026-06-03 and recorded them in the web search history.

uncertainty_notes: Public macOS distribution readiness remains outside this package-manager migration and is still governed by existing signing/notarization blockers.
limitation_notes: This grounding check covers the close-out claims for the pnpm migration, not historical npm references inside earlier audit or evaluation records.
